_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact, and gated three ways: the 6 rows sum to 15,853.13, which equals the table's own printed TOTAL line, the sum of the page's two boxes (15,803.13 + 50.00), and the module's stated figure. The split is exact on both sides too - the five rows above $50 sum to 15,803.13 and Thelma Whitehouse's single $50.00 is the '<=$50' box - so there is no structural residual. GRAIN: cumulative, and unambiguous; the 11/4/14 row alone is the cover's Current-Report figure of 2,320.17 and the other five sum to the Last Report figure of 13,532.96. No specimen row exists to drop (see page_gates). No in-kind schedule. THE HEADLINE FACT: $15,253.13 of the $15,853.13 - 96.2% - is the candidate's own household, itemized under her and her husband's names; the outside money on this $15.9k campaign is four gifts totalling $600, two of them from out of state.

expenditures.detail: exact to the cent - 41 rows sum to 15,853.13, equal to the schedule's printed box, to the table's own TOTAL line, and to the cover. No cell needed escalation: the page is typed and clean. The TOTAL line is dropped as a non-transaction. The running sum also reproduces the cover's period split exactly (rows 1-38 = 13,532.96 = Last Report; rows 39-41 = 2,320.17 = Current Report), which is independent confirmation that the ledger is cumulative and complete.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: Three pages: p1 cover (already transcribed), p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT, p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT. This is the most professionally prepared filing in the chunk: the candidate DELETED the blank form's 40-row grid and PASTED IN HER OWN TYPED TABLES, sized to the number of rows she actually had - 6 contribution rows and 41 expense rows - each ending in a TOTAL line she computed herself. A consequence worth stating plainly: THERE ARE NO SPECIMEN ROWS ON THIS FILING, because the printed 'Jon and Jane Doe' / 'Name of Business' examples went with the grid she replaced. The specimen-drop gate is a no-op here, and its absence is not an omission. CONTRIBUTION GATE: p2 prints '>$50 $15,803.13' and '<=$50 $50.00', and the table's own TOTAL line prints $15,853.13. The 6 rows sum to 15,853.13 to the cent, which is both boxes together and the module's stated total. EXPENSE GATE: p3 prints '$15,853.13' in its box and again on its TOTAL line; the 41 rows sum to 15,853.13 to the cent. Both TOTAL lines are dropped as non-transactions (they carry no date, no payee and no donor). The ledgers are CUMULATIVE and provably so from the page: the first 38 expense rows sum to 13,532.96, exactly the cover's Last Report cell, and the last three - which are typed in a different font - sum to 2,320.17, exactly its Current Report cell.

_meta_itemized.notes: Corrie Forsling, County Treasurer, 2014 Post-Election - the losing candidate's opponent in this chunk's other Treasurer pair (Amy Yost, 1098/1268). Raised and spent $15,853.13 and closed at exactly zero. SOURCE PROPERTIES WORTH RECORDING: (1) A FILER CAN REPLACE THE FORM'S TABLE ENTIRELY. Both schedules here are the filer's own typed tables pasted over the county's 40-row grid, right-sized to her data and each carrying its own TOTAL line. That has three consequences the wave should expect to meet again: there are NO SPECIMEN ROWS to drop; there IS a TOTAL row inside the table that must be dropped (it sits in the Mailing Address / Purpose column with an amount beside it and would otherwise double the schedule); and the row pitch is the filer's, not the form's, so the printed grid still measures cleanly but at a different pitch on each page (1.5569% on p2, 1.64% on p3). (2) THE POST-ELECTION ADDITIONS ARE VISIBLE IN THE TYPEFACE. Expense rows 39-41 are set in a sans-serif font while rows 1-38 are serif - the filer appended three lines to the table she had already filed rather than retyping it. Those three rows sum to the cover's Current-Report cell to the cent. A font change is not usually data, but here it marks the period boundary inside a cumulative ledger, and it is the reason this filing needs no grain ruling. (3) NEAR-TOTAL SELF-FUNDING. 96.2% of the money is the candidate's own household ($12,932.96 on 10/25 and $2,320.17 on 11/4), and the second figure is exactly the post-election spend - the household topped the account up to zero after the election. Four outside gifts totalling $600 are the entire donor base, two of them from Florida and North Carolina. (4) A TYPO IN THE FILER'S OWN ADDRESS: the two Forsling rows print 8797 and 8798 Lone Pine Ct. Retained as filed; the street is discarded at read time regardless. PRIVACY: p2 prints a Mailing Address and Zipcode column; all six street addresses and the one PO box were discarded AT READ TIME and none appears in this record. donor_city / donor_state only, read from the address cell and never from the zip - which is why Robert Hilder's row has BOTH blank: his cell holds a PO box and nothing else. Nothing on this filing is redacted by the county. GEOMETRY: the two pages are handled differently on the evidence of what each supports. p3's grid detects perfectly - 45 bands and a full five-rule column set from 7.53% to 85.59%, so the box spans date through amount - and its 41 rows carry MEASURED geometry at bands 3..43 (bands 1-2 are the page's top rule and the header; band 44 is the dropped TOTAL line). Verified by crop at band 3 (Online Candidate.com / website design/hosting / 438.95) and band 43 (Facebook / ads 10/1 thru 11/4 / 1,158.25). p2's detection is CONTAMINATED - 22 'bands' of 0.5-0.8% height, because the page is 90% empty white and its own text lines are the strongest horizontal features - so its 6 rows use a DECLARED frame (force_declared, x=7.3 y0=19.136 pitch=1.55688 w=82.5) fitted to the 9 rules measured in a narrow x-slice of the RAW page, and verified by crop at band 2 (Fred & Grace Whitehouse / 200.00) and band 7 (Scott & Corrie Forsling / 2,320.17). On p2 band 1 is the column header and band 8 the TOTAL line.
